verses.1: Therefore, having received this duty as it was assigned to us, we do not refuse to carry out it.
verses.2: But let us avoid hiding the secrets of shamefulness. Let us not engage in any wickedness or commit any sin against God’s word. Instead, let us reveal the truth before all people, in front of God’s eyes.
verses.3: And even though our gospel may be hidden from some, it is still hidden from those who are lost.
verses.4: In which, the God of this age has blinded the eyes of those who do not believe, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel of Christ’s glory. He is indeed the image of God.
verses.5: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Christ Jesus, the Lord; we are merely your servants through Jesus.
verses.6: For God said: “From darkness shall light emerge.” This light is the one that has been kindled in our hearts, as a sign of the knowledge and glory of God in the face of Christ.
verses.7: We have this treasure stored in containers made of wood, so that the excess of our strength won’t be a curse from God, and it won’t come from us.
verses.8: In every situation, they are suffering, but they do not give up. They are exhausted, but they do not completely lose hope.
verses.9: Forced to flee, yet not abandoned; forced to endure, yet not given up.
verses.10: Always, when we mourn the death of Jesus in His body, we should also let the life of Jesus in His body be revealed to us.
verses.11: For we, who are living for death, will always be given over by Jesus, so that even the life of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
verses.12: So that death works in us, while life works in you.
verses.13: Having that same spirit of faith, as it is written: “I believed, therefore I spoke.” And we believe, therefore we speak.
verses.14: You know that the risen Jesus and we along with Jesus have been raised from the dead, and He will show us the way.
verses.15: For all things are done through you, so that the grace of God may be increased through your kindness and praise before God’s glory.
verses.16: Therefore, we do not give up. Even if the people outside us are destroyed, those inside us will be renewed day by day.
verses.17: For it excessively burdens us with sorrow, turning it into an eternal burden of honor.
verses.18: They do not focus on what we can see, but on what we cannot see. For what we can see is temporary, while what we cannot see is eternal.
